Glycolysis is defined as the metabolic pathway that converts glucose into pyruvate, with lactate being an alternative end product under anaerobic conditions. Glycogen breakdown to glucose-1-phosphate is part of glycogenolysis, not glycolysis. Conversion to fructose or acetyl CoA (the latter being the entry point into the citric acid cycle after pyruvate dehydrogenase reaction) is not the definition of glycolysis.  

Final answer: (C)
